text:
anya: Quick heads-up — we're sketching the v1 sunset UX in Console. Need two things: a clear compatibility signal for tenants and a predictable description of how routing + billing behave when we fallback to a compatible variant. Thoughts?

mike: High level: three pieces — (1) compatibility state (compatible/partial/breaking), (2) routing outcome (pinned -> same, header -> prefer, else default to v2), (3) billing model (bill for executed model).

jess: For Console copy, I like short labels not panic banners. Maybe a compact card: 'Compatibility: PARTIAL' with a tooltip that shows examples and a small estimated "traffic if switched" bar. Avoid language like "you will be blocked". :thinking:

sre-kat: Routing reality: current algorithm is: tenant pin > X-Model-Version header > route default. If mismatch and models are compatible we do variant fallthrough; if incompatible we return 409. We'll add a telemetry tag `compat_status` and `route_outcome` for every request.

anya: Good. We also need to show expected error lift if tenant flips. Eg show estimated 5xx delta. How will we compute that cheaply?

mike: Use sampling + historical mapping: sample 1% of requests, run them against the candidate model in staging to estimate delta, then extrapolate. Add a confidence interval. That gives Console the "if switched" projection.

jess: UI: show projection with a tiny confidence badge (low/med/high). Also expose a "simulate" button that runs a probe cohort (10k requests) before tenant action.

rafael: I'm down to run the probe but need an opt-in header so we can isolate telemetry: `X-Compat-Probe: true`. Can also tag traces.

mike: agreed, we'll add header and route sample traffic to a probe bucket. Start at 0.5% and ramp.

anya: Billing question — if we route v1 -> v2 shim and v2 has different per-token rate, what do we show in Console and what do we invoice? We need to avoid surprises.

sre-kat: Billing system currently records executed model and token usage at execution time. So invoice uses executed model's rate. But Console can show an "Estimated cost change" based on the project's current usage and the candidate model's per-token price.

mike: Implementation note: expose `billing_model_id` in the routing event so cost estimator can compute deltas client-side. Also emit `quota_conversion_factor` when models have drastically different tokenization assumptions.

jess: Copy proposal: "Requests may be routed to compatible model variants. Billing reflects the model that actually served the request. Console shows an estimate of cost difference before you confirm." Short, clear.

anya: Good. Telemetry checklist: `compat_status`, `route_outcome`, `billing_model_id`, `quota_conversion_factor`, `probe_flag`. Also a sampled full trace for mismatch cases.

rafael: I'll add probe runner to QA tomorrow. Can we get a feature branch to run a dry cohort on staging?

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: feature/compat-insights -> staging (sha: a1b2c3d) :rocket:

mike: QA checklist (internal): 1) tags present on all code paths; 2) cost delta calculation matches billing table; 3) probe header respected; 4) UI copy review; 5) rollback hook (console toggle) works.

anya: Owners: mike -> routing + billing signal, jess -> Console UX + copy, sre-kat -> telemetry tagging, rafael -> QA/probe runs. I'll file follow-ups after this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:

mike: One more tiny ask — log a compact sample of raw request/response for 100 mismatches per day (PII scrubbed) so SRE/ML can debug compatibility issues.

sre-kat: ok will add scrubber and retention policy (7 days) to the probe pipeline.

anya: Great. I'll open a draft PR with UI mock and link it here when ready.
